title: MaleTheme Duo #010 · 남 V자 보디빌더·피치 듀이·닌자 테마 / 남 클래식 머슬·실버 포일·경찰관 테마·투톤
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a snow-covered stone plaza in soft daylight with light snow lying only on the ground, a fountain edge under snow, standard lamp posts and a waist-high railing, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Nigerian man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, deep rich dark-brown skin with a smooth satin glow, a cool composed look, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (an iron miniature anvil, a silver cube-shaped block, an iron small flared temple bell, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold anklets. LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Kenyan man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, silver foil-lined eyes with a cool shimmer, deep ebony skin with a soft glow, a confident smirk, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a bronze hammer head, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver pyramid-shaped lump, an iron ship's anchor, a tin round bell, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold necklaces. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black police cap with a silver badge, a thin black leather chest harness carrying a silver badge, steel handcuffs hanging from one hip string, and a minimal black and white two-tone leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
